audience_description: School Principals in Eduversal partner schools. Holds ultimate accountability for academic outcomes, instructional quality, operational management, compliance, and the school's relationship with yayasan and Eduversal. New principals are simultaneously enrolled in the 12-month Principal Induction track (Induction Module: Principal 26-27) — induction-overlay tasks layer on the weekly cadence for first-year principals.

source_inheritance.primary_source_description: The Eduversal Principal Operating Cadence v1.0 — 83 tasks across P1-P8 foci, fully Cambridge + Permendikbud + Permendikdasmen anchored. This file is the authoritative source for Principal weekly tasks.
source_inheritance.this_file_role: Adapter / mapping layer between the cadence file's 8-focus structure (P1-P8) and the weekly-checklist module's week-by-week structure. The seed script reads BOTH this file AND principal-operating-cadence.json, then expands cadence tasks onto the appropriate weeks.
source_inheritance.do_not_duplicate: Tasks defined in principal-operating-cadence.json must NOT be re-defined here. This file references them by id (e.g. T-P1-001) and adds only the week-mapping metadata.

framework_anchors.appraisal_framework: Principal Appraisal: Handbook 26-27 — F1 Operating Cadence Compliance, F2 Leadership Observation, F3 Stakeholder 360 Feedback, F4 Outcome Indicators, F5 Self-Assessment & Reflection (plus F_LEAD at Lead level). The Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director is the primary appraiser; the Foundation Representative / General Manager co-reviews and co-signs the summary. A Year-1 principal receives no formal appraisal.

task_categories: Inherited — P1-P8 from principal-operating-cadence.json. Mapped to weekly-checklist categories C1-C6 below.

cadence_to_week_expansion.description: How the seeder maps cadence tasks (D/W/M/T/A/X) to weeks 1-40.

rules.daily: Lands in weekly_essentials/school_principal — present every week, surfaced as standing items.
rules.monthly: Lands on weeks 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40 (Week 4 of every month).
rules.termly: Lands on weeks 17, 38 (end of Sem-1, end of Sem-2). Some tasks specify exact weeks via specific_timing — those override.
rules.annually: Each annual task has specific_timing in cadence file (e.g. 'May-June') — the seeder maps to the corresponding weeks (e.g. May = W31-32, June = W37-39).
rules.adhoc: Lands in weekly_essentials with adhoc=true flag — UI surfaces only when triggered (not weekly).

week_specific_overrides.description: Cases where the cadence file's specific_timing maps to specific weeks, OR where a task is added beyond the cadence file (Eduversal-network-specific events).

1.comment: Annual Eduversal network strategic alignment workshop — July, lands W1.

4.eduversal_specific: Lead first ALT Dashboard Review for the year — review baseline walkthroughs and Domain Heatmap formation.

5.comment: RKT/RKAS preparation begins May-June for following July — but for schools mid-cycle, W5 is the RKAS implementation review point.

3-8.eduversal_specific: School Appraisal Phase 1 — Teaching Quality Visit (on-site, live window 5 August – 18 September 2026; the school's exact date is in its own schedule). Phase 0 — Kickoff runs online about three weeks before. Prepare the documentation, the classroom observation schedule and the Self-Evaluation according to the School Appraisal: Handbook 26-27.

7-13.eduversal_specific: Principal Appraisal — first leadership-observation (F2) window, Sept–Oct 2026, by the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director or an assigned observer, for principals in the Principal Appraisal cycle. It may share a trip with a School Appraisal visit; the two stay separate.

8.eduversal_specific: Cambridge Oct/Nov standard entry deadline — Principal final sign-off of all candidate entries across departments.

10.eduversal_specific: EASE Week 1 — mid-Semester I; EASE Growth (Grades 7-12) runs in the first two periods and lessons continue. Live date: Semester I school week 12, 28 Sep – 2 Oct 2026 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).

10-11.eduversal_specific: School Appraisal Phase 2 — Progress Check-in (online) with the Visit I Supervisor, completed by 18 October 2026.

11-15.eduversal_specific: School Appraisal Phase 3 — Validation Visit (on-site, live window 7 October – 20 November 2026). Update the Self-Evaluation before the visit. The Annual School Quality Report follows within three weeks, with a Development Rating for each of the five domains.

10-12.comment: Monthly Cambridge progress review intensifies — Oct/Nov exam window.

14-15.eduversal_specific: EASE Week 2 — Semester I Synchronized Test (EASE Assessment / Common Assessment); lessons stop. Principal oversees administration, ensures protocol compliance, escalates anomalies to Eduversal. Where a Cambridge exam replaces the Synchronized Test for a grade or subject, the live schedule applies. Live date: Semester I school week 22 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).

16-17.comment: End-of-Sem-1 internal moderation and standardisation — Principal-led across departments.
Sem-1 grading integrity audit — Principal reviews 10% sample (Section 9.10).

18.eduversal_specific: Sem-1 close — Principal signs off all reports before issuance to parents. Termly improvement plan addendum filed.

19.eduversal_specific: Mid-year check of the teacher appraisal cycle: every teacher in the Teacher Appraisal population has had at least three formal F2 observations in Semester I, recorded in Edunav (Teacher Appraisal: Handbook 26-27). Within two weeks of the Annual School Quality Report, the two School Development Priorities are in the School Development Plan.

20.eduversal_specific: Mid-year network leadership conference — Principal attends, reports school progress, hears network priorities.

22.comment: Cambridge Oct/Nov results released — Principal leads cross-department analysis, files report to yayasan + Eduversal.

22-31.eduversal_specific: Principal Appraisal — second leadership-observation (F2) window, Feb–Apr 2027, for principals in the Principal Appraisal cycle.

25.eduversal_specific: Cambridge May/June standard entry deadline — Principal final sign-off.
EASE Week 3 — mid-Semester II; EASE Growth (Grades 7-12; exam-heavy grades may sit earlier); lessons continue. Live date: Semester II school week 13 (Secondary).

31-35.comment: Cambridge May/June exam series — daily Principal oversight.

33-35.eduversal_specific: EASE Week 4 — Semester II Synchronized Test (EASE Assessment / Common Assessment); lessons stop. Principal oversees administration. Live date: Semester II school week 19 (EASE Module: Schedule 26-27).

35.comment: Annual EDS review begins — Principal leads with TPS.

36-37.comment: Annual RKT and RKAS preparation for following year.

36-39.eduversal_specific: School Appraisal Phase 4 — Impact Review (online, May–June 2027): review the two School Development Priorities — what was implemented, what changed, the evidence of impact, what still needs work, and what carries forward. Phase 4 creates no new Domain Rating.

38.comment: Termly + annual school improvement plan progress review.
Annual teacher appraisal cycle close — Principal final sign-off.

39.comment: Annual report to yayasan — final preparation and presentation.

39.eduversal_specific: Principal Appraisal year-end evidence: the annual F5 reflection and the late-year / year-end 360 cycle (the official F3 evidence), for principals in the Principal Appraisal cycle — not Year-1 principals in induction.

40.comment: Annual visi-misi review with leadership team and yayasan.

40.eduversal_specific: Year-end Governance Archive Audit — Principal certifies completeness.

induction_overlay.applies_when: users.induction_status in {pre_arrival, listen, diagnose, act, anchor}
induction_overlay.source: Induction Module: Principal 26-27 (live Google Doc) — repo mirror docs/induction/handbook-principal-v1.json
induction_overlay.alignment_note: Principal Induction runs 12 months from the principal's own start date, in four windows of about 90 days: Listen (days 1–90), Diagnose (91–180), Act (181–270), Anchor (271–365), after Stage 0 — Preparation (up to 45 days before arrival). The week numbers below assume a start in week 1 and are approximate; a principal who starts mid-year follows the day count, not the school calendar. A Year-1 principal receives no formal appraisal (Principal NN1).

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Mentor call with your Principal Mentor
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: 60-minute video call with your external Eduversal Principal Mentor: weekly in Window 1 (Listen), bi-weekly in Windows 2 and 3, and monthly in Window 4. In Window 3 the mentor also makes one in-person school visit. Eduversal selects and assigns the mentor — an experienced Eduversal Subject Specialist with a prior school leadership background, the Foundation Representative of a different partner school, or a network-experienced retired principal under an Eduversal contract. The mentor holds active Eduversal Mentor Certification and completes a one-hour Principal Mentor Briefing; no separate endorsement document is required.

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Induction journal — listening-visit notes and reflections
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: Private notes and reflections, visible only to you, your mentor and — where a task says so — your Foundation Representative / General Manager (FR/GM). Eduversal never reads named entries (Charter NN2). Nothing in the journal is used to judge you.

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Window deliverables — written, reviewed by your mentor
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: School State Report (1 page, end of Window 1 — shared with your mentor and FR/GM); 3-Priority School Plan (2 pages, Window 2 — reviewed by your mentor, signed off by your FR/GM before you present it to staff); Mid-Year Reflection (1 page, Window 3); Year-2 plan and End-of-Year Principal Report (Window 4). The Induction Coordinator reviews the End-of-Year Report with your mentor's induction note and signs off completion — completed / withdrew. These are induction deliverables, not an evaluation: a Year-1 principal receives no formal appraisal.
evidence_required: Deliverable shared with mentor (and FR/GM where stated)

extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.title: Weekly pulse
extra_recurring_tasks_first_year.description: The same one-question, 5-emoji "How was your week?" check-in used across all Eduversal induction tracks. It is anonymised at network level and exists to notice when you need support — care, not surveillance. It never feeds appraisal.

feeds_into: principal_appraisal v1 F1 (Cadence Compliance) — direct evidence
principal_appraisal v1 F2 (Leadership Observation) — from the scheduled leadership-observation visits (Sept–Oct and Feb–Apr), not from the weekly checklist
